SECOND COAST BRAKE BAND
INSPECTION

INSPECT BRAKE BAND
If the lining of the brake band is peeling off or discolored,
or even part of the printed numbers are defaced, replace
the brake band.
HINT: Before assembling the new band, soak it in ATF for
at least 15 minutes.

Printed
Number
Y 003915

AX0AK-0D
SECOND COAST BRAKE PISTON
ASSEMBLY

1. SELECT PISTON ROD
If the band is OK with piston stroke not within the standard
value, select a new piston rod.
There are 2 different lengths of piston rod.
Piston rod length:
71.4 mm (2.811 in.)
72.9 mm (2.870 in.)

AT7705

2. INSTALL PISTON ROD
(a) Install the retainer, compression spring and piston to the
piston rod.

Piston Rod
Retainer
Spring
Piston
AT5206

(b) Firmly hold down the piston, then compress the compression spring.
(c) Using needle-nose pliers, install the E-ring.
